scope: Add direct AC1024 ASCII/Binary allocation-failure coverage for the profiled BLOCKSTRETCHACTION writer, including caller-state and source-identity rollback, remapped references, and retry/readback.

change.testCoverage: The generated low-level test uses one BLOCKSTRETCHACTION with two action indexes, one dependency handle, two stretch points, two remapped handle references with nested index counts, and one code-reference index vector.
change.perEncoding: ASCII and Binary each exercise 14 allocation offsets. Every injected failure preserves the source fields and leaves no sourceHandleToWrittenObjectMap entry. Fresh-writer retries read back the owner and dependency handles, remapped handle-reference targets, ordered indexes, counts, connection names, stretch coordinates, and subclass.
change.existingAdapterControl: The existing dwg2dxf_dynamic_block_actions_writer CTest continues to verify exact wire order, typed readback, unknown-tail handling, and destination-preserving corrected retry for MoveAction, ScaleAction, and StretchAction profiles.

limitations: Fault injection covers the low-level record writer, not the enclosing whole-file output transaction.
A fresh writer is used after a fault because the failed writer may retain partial stream bytes and a sticky error.
The generated action profile does not establish physical producer breadth, complete graph closure, or native action semantics.
No DWG/DXF fixture is added and no support claim is promoted.
nextReadyPacket: Continue P6 caller-state/no-loss auditing on a source-backed, locally implementable writer gap; keep production and native gates separate.
